question: why the lost deals are heppens?

WITH rpt_deals AS (
SELECT src.id, src.organization_id, src.title, src.stage, src.amount, src.currency_code, src.stage_weight, src.weighted_amount, src.company_id, src.company_name, src.company_industry, src.location_id, src.contact_id, src.contact_name, src.contact_email, src.owner_user_id, src.owner_name, src.created_at, src.closed_at, src.close_ts, src.updated_at, src.expected_close_date, src.lost_reason, src.is_open, src.is_won, src.is_lost, src.aging_days, src.forecast_category, src.forecast_reason, src.forecast_flagged FROM (
SELECT 
  d.id,
  d.organization_id,
  d.title,
  d.stage,
  COALESCE(d.amount, 0) AS amount,
  CASE
    WHEN pq.currency IS NOT NULL AND pq.currency <> 'USD' THEN pq.currency
    WHEN o.country IS NOT NULL AND o.country <> 'US' AND cc.curr IS NOT NULL THEN cc.curr
    WHEN pq.currency = 'USD' THEN 'USD'
    WHEN o.country = 'US' THEN 'USD'
    ELSE 'USD'
  END AS currency_code,
  CASE d.stage
    WHEN 'qualification' THEN 0.10
    WHEN 'discover' THEN 0.25
    WHEN 'propose' THEN 0.50
    WHEN 'negotiate' THEN 0.75
    WHEN 'closed_won' THEN 1.00
    WHEN 'closed_lost' THEN 0.00
    ELSE 0.00
  END AS stage_weight,
  ROUND(COALESCE(d.amount, 0) * (
    CASE d.stage
      WHEN 'qualification' THEN 0.10
      WHEN 'discover' THEN 0.25
      WHEN 'propose' THEN 0.50
      WHEN 'negotiate' THEN 0.75
      WHEN 'closed_won' THEN 1.00
      WHEN 'closed_lost' THEN 0.00
      ELSE 0.00
    END
  ), 2) AS weighted_amount,
  d.company_id,
  c.name AS company_name,
  c.industry AS company_industry,
  d.location_id,
  d.contact_id,
  COALESCE(d.contact_name, cdp.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(cdp.last_name, '')) AS contact_name,
  COALESCE(d.contact_email, id_k.key_value) AS contact_email,
  d.owner_user_id,
  su.first_name || ' ' || COALESCE(su.last_name, '') AS owner_name,
  d.created_at,
  d.closed_at,
  COALESCE(d.closed_at, d.created_at) AS close_ts,
  d.updated_at,
  d.expected_close_date,
  d.lost_reason,
  (d.stage IN ('qualification', 'discover', 'propose', 'negotiate')) AS is_open,
  (d.stage = 'closed_won') AS is_won,
  (d.stage = 'closed_lost') AS is_lost,
  FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - d.created_at))/86400)::integer AS aging_days,
  d.forecast_category,
  d.forecast_reason,
  d.forecast_flagged
FROM crm.deals d
LEFT JOIN crm.companies c ON c.id = d.company_id AND c.organization_id = d.organization_id
LEFT JOIN accounts.setup_users su ON su.id = d.owner_user_id
LEFT JOIN accounts.organizations o ON o.id = d.organization_id
LEFT JOIN cdp.customer_profile cdp ON cdp.cdp_id = d.contact_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ik.key_value 
  FROM cdp.identity_keys ik 
  WHERE ik.cdp_id = d.contact_id AND ik.key_type = 'email' AND ik.organization_id = d.organization_id 
  ORDER BY ik.created_at ASC 
  LIMIT 1
) id_k ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT q.currency 
  FROM crm.quotes q 
  WHERE q.deal_id = d.id AND q.organization_id = d.organization_id 
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN q.status = 'accepted' THEN 1 WHEN q.status = 'sent' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, q.updated_at DESC 
  LIMIT 1
) pq ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT CASE o.country 
    WHEN 'India' THEN 'INR' 
    WHEN 'United Kingdom' THEN 'GBP' 
    WHEN 'Germany' THEN 'EUR' 
    WHEN 'Canada' THEN 'CAD' 
    WHEN 'Australia' THEN 'AUD' 
    ELSE 'USD' 
  END AS curr
) cc ON TRUE
WHERE d.organization_id = %(_org_id)s
) src WHERE TRUE
)
SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS lost_deal_count FROM rpt_deals AS deals WHERE is_lost = TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE AND TRUE LIMIT 500

task.goal: Get a breakdown of empirical lost reasons from the warehouse

tasks.sql:
MATCH (d:Deal)
WHERE toLower(d.stage) = 'closed_lost'
  AND ($can_view_all = true OR d.owner_user_id = $effective_user_id)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:HAS]->(q:Quote)
WITH d, collect(q) AS quotes
WITH d,
     [q IN quotes WHERE toLower(q.approval_status) = 'approved'][0] AS approved_quote,
     quotes[0] AS any_quote
WITH d,
     coalesce(approved_quote.currency, any_quote.currency, d.currency, $default_currency, 'INR') AS currency,
     coalesce(d.amount, approved_quote.total, any_quote.total, 0) AS final_amount
RETURN coalesce(d.lost_reason, 'Unspecified') AS lost_reason,
       currency,
       count(d) AS lost_deals_count,
       sum(coalesce(final_amount, 0)) AS total_lost_amount,
       collect({
         deal_id: d.id,
         title: d.title,
         amount: final_amount,
         currency: currency,
         lost_reason: d.lost_reason,
         closed_at: d.closed_at
       })[0..5] AS sample_deals
ORDER BY total_lost_amount DESC
LIMIT 100
